_: Off-season blurbs for the Teams view's form block (app.js renderTeamForm): shown before a season starts and once one is well over. Plain text, one per team slug. Edit freely — nothing generates this file.
broncos: The Broncos' season runs September to January at Empower Field at Mile High, eight or nine regular-season home dates on Sundays with a Monday or Thursday night most years; the schedule drops in May.
nuggets: The Nuggets play October to April at Ball Arena, 41 home dates, with the playoffs from mid-April; the schedule arrives in August.
avalanche: The Avalanche's season runs October to April at Ball Arena, 41 home dates, with the Stanley Cup playoffs from mid-April; the schedule is out in early July.
rockies: The Rockies open at Coors Field in late March or early April and play through September, 81 home dates; the schedule is published the summer before.
rapids: The Rapids' MLS season runs late February to October at Dick's Sporting Goods Park in Commerce City, 17 home dates, with the Cup playoffs into December; the schedule arrives in December.
pioneers: Pioneers hockey runs October to March at Magness Arena, about 18 home dates in Friday–Saturday pairs, with the NCHC playoffs and the Frozen Four into April; the schedule is out by August.
buffs: Buffs football runs late August to November at Folsom Field in Boulder, six or seven home Saturdays; the schedule is set in the winter.
buffsbasketball: Buffs basketball runs November to March at the CU Events Center in Boulder, 16 or 17 home dates, with the Big 12 tournament and March Madness after; the schedule is out in the autumn.
